subject: AcmeCloud / Redwood — procurement readiness & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecloud.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud / Redwood — procurement readiness & mutual action plan

Hi Alex — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment across procurement/security/finance: 

1) Stakeholders we heard on the call:
- Alex Johnson (Procurement, AcmeCloud)
- Priya N. (Security)
- Daniel K. (Finance)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood AE) / Camila Reyes (SE)

2) Procurement path + question for you:
- Looks like AcmeCloud prefers a PO for enterprise agreements. Quick ask: do you have appetite to purchase via your cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) instead, or is the PO path required for vendor vetting (preferred)?

3) Typical internal milestones we expect for similar deals:
- Legal review (T&C and SOC addenda): ~1-2 weeks
- Security review (questionnaire + call): ~1 week (can be parallel to legal)
- Finance review / PO issuance: ~1 week after approvals

4) Proposed mutual action plan (draft attached):
- Security questionnaire answers by 2026-03-20
- Legal review complete by 2026-03-25
- PO issued by 2026-03-29

Attachments: redwood-mutual-action-plan-acmecloud-v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Actions for Alex: please confirm whether AcmeCloud will proceed via PO or Marketplace, and whether the target dates above look feasible. If PO, please share any PO template or procurement contact we should loop in.

I'll loop in Marcus (sales ops) and Camila (SE) to prepare a short commercial quote + security artifacts.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | High-performance LLM inference for production
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud / Redwood — procurement readiness & mutual action plan

Thanks Marissa — very helpful summary. A few notes from Procurement & Finance: 

- Procurement preference: PO (preferred) for enterprise vendors. Marketplace is possible but will add an additional vendor onboarding step; we prefer PO for speed.
- Typical timeline here: legal review ~2 weeks, security review ~1 week (can be in parallel), finance/PO issuance ~1 week after approvals. So the timeline you proposed looks reasonable.
- Approval path: Legal -> Security -> Finance. I will start routing SOW/quote to Legal next week.

Requests:
- Please send a formal quote/SOW and indicate payment terms (net30, net45, etc.)
- We will need a copy of standard terms and a SOC2 or ISO attestation/description of data handling for the security team.

I'll CC our procurement mailbox. Once we have the SOW/quote we will kick off internal routing.

Alex Johnson
Senior Procurement Manager, AcmeCloud
alex.johnson@acmecloud.com
